findings.description: The title says Request.headers moves back to Mapping, but the attribute is annotated as Mapping[str, object], not Mapping[str, str | bytes]. The same widening to object is applied to HeadersType.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes headers={'X': 1} or any non-str/bytes value. The type checker now accepts it, though the value can't be sent as a header value. Impact: type errors are no longer caught statically and surface at runtime when the request is prepared or sent. The title announces only the move to Mapping, so the loosened value type goes beyond the stated change.
